learnings: Store and compare times in UTC; convert with `zoneinfo` only for display.
Exact age compares (month, day) tuples – `days // 365` is wrong near birthdays.
The same wall-clock time has different UTC offsets in winter and summer (DST).
pitfalls: `datetime.now()` without a timezone is naive and can't be compared with aware times.
